| description = Spawns are much more prevalent at night time. Seen often around the iksar bandit camp (just south of FoB zoneline) (despawn at 7am).

Tewaz's note: These start spawning at 8PM more frequently on Blue. They path on the hill to the east of the bandit camp. I used /pet attack froglok_r to know when they popped. They do not appear to have placeholders that I could find. It took probably 10 night cycles to get all the pages and the binder. Each one drops a page unless they drop the binder. I had all the pages after 2-3 cycles.

Notes from 25-26 Feb 2023 on green: These spawn both at night *and during the day*. Seem to be more common at night. My total raiders killed to receive all pages and tome: 40. (Seems like this might have been lucky, or the drop rate has improved over the years, as others have reported killing 100+ raiders historically.)

27OCT25 Notes: Found three static spawns. Each of these can spawn froglok raider or a PH (random). Seems to be 6:00 respawn for these.

<li>(2325,-520)</li>
<li>(2390,295)</li></ul>
